9f0e03828825998efbccf589350e9c74dd9704dc.sourceText: 为了获得最佳结果，可以多次执行上述流程。每次执行后，测量并记录新的实际转角位移数据和rviz2中的坐标系相对关系，然后根据新的数据再次修正旋转半径。通过不断迭代这个过程，可以逐步优化旋转半径的估计值，减小转角位移的测量误差。
9f0e03828825998efbccf589350e9c74dd9704dc.translatedText: To obtain the best results, the above process can be executed multiple times\. After each execution, measure and record the new actual angular displacement data and the coordinate system relationship in rviz2, and then correct the rotation radius again based on the new data\. By continuously iterating this process, the estimated value of the rotation radius can be gradually optimized, reducing the measurement error of the angular displacement\.

9f43a8b4140af3192aee928c9f380768b59e1455.translatedText: This is especially what to look at on a downhill slope: the lower side of a normal slope may simply be the representative ground lower than this small patch, and is not a true pit\. Conversely, a true depression can be represented through this height difference only if it is seen by radar and leaves a valid echo; a cliff with no echo does not automatically become reliably identified because of this\. The expansion node also does not have the near\-field `noDataObstacle` synthetic obstacle function; how areas without points affect planning still depends on the downstream unknown\-area settings\.
